source_identity.finding: The six-storey, five-bay front, narrow slots and asymmetric recessed loggias, timber frame, flat planted roof and offset canopy/core retain the exact source identity at clay detail level.

Both previously opaque first side ground-floor bays now show recessed framed glazing and room depth. Front-left loggia and rear slot-window stacks stay repaired. All corner exposures read as open-plan glazed rooms rather than pale plates crossing apertures.

Loggia returns, recessed panes, narrow window sills, projecting frame and guardrails remain visibly distinct. Facade close shows cut-wall depth and occupied room planes behind the optical layer without opaque infill crossing the reviewed openings.

Central double glazed entry, handles, canopy and seated stoop remain legible; glass_close shows jambs, head, threshold, glazing and occupied depth. The lobby stair is visible from the left-side ground floor. This proves conceptual exterior access, not a complete internal egress or accessibility design.

Posts bear at grade, beams/roof caps remain seated, balcony floor/return/guard relationships are coherent, and roof canopy supports visibly meet its deck and cap. No floating roof structures or exposed envelope gaps found in the rendered roster.

Perimeter roof beds and inner longitudinal bed now carry continuous low groundcover below botanical shrubs and branching trees. This restores the planted-roof reading in aerial, top, roof_garden and phoneboard while keeping a clear circulation loop and core/pavilion access. More regular planting than the photograph is acceptable within this clay profile.

Whole-elevation and oblique cameras retain the footprint and crown with neutral margins. All named detail proofs are legible. Top framing is conservative but its topology remains readable and is supported by closer aerial/roof_garden images.
Restrained timber, dark glazing/metal, neutral roof and foliage colours remain coherent. Source material texture, weathering and fine grain are outside this architectural-clay review.

This visual pass does not prove browser loading, frame time, memory, scene repetition or runtime placement. Optimize and test separately before any runtime acceptance; any changed GLB needs its own hash and appropriate reimport evidence.
